title: Keep accented letters in the web address form of a task title
statement: The short web address that is made from a task title throws accented letters away: Café Menü comes out as caf-men. Keep them as their plain letters instead, so that it comes out as cafe-menu. The text helpers reach the application as a library archive that is copied in as a file, so the application has to take the rebuilt archive and the new archive has to carry a new version number.
